column1: # Java server-fix baseline: branch 26.2, commit b6ab4d366af3e10fda408b062a804805f39adedf (unshaded production classes)
# INTENTIONAL IMPLEMENTATION-FLAG DIFFERENCE: the original Java init/start/stop methods
# have SYNCHRONIZED. Only those three expected flags are removed below: Kotlin uses
# explicit synchronized(Webserver.class) blocks so Java and Companion callers share
# one monitor without a second Companion lock. Names/descriptors/access/generics stay
# unchanged; WebserverCompatibilityCheck verifies both actual entrypoints and rejects
# the old Companion-only behavior. This is not an unmodified Java flag snapshot.
